headline_marked: BIWTA [[Director temporarily suspended]] over corruption and scandal allegations
headline: BIWTA Director temporarily suspended over corruption and scandal allegations
summary: AKM Arif Uddin was suspended after videos surfaced on social media alleging misconduct and a scandal involving a woman.
details: Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority (BIWTA) Director (Ports and Transport) AKM Arif Uddin has been temporarily suspended from service.
The action was taken following the publication of videos on social media platforms that alleged corruption, misconduct, and a scandal involving a woman.
BIWTA Chairman Md Muhidul Islam signed the office order on Tuesday, stating that the authority's image has been tarnished by these allegations.
The suspension is based on the violation of Rule 35(b) and (e) of the Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority Employees Service Regulations, 1990.
During the suspension, Arif Uddin will receive a food allowance as per rules, but he is required to attend the Administration and Human Resources Department of BIWTA regularly.
Md Saiful Islam, Director (Administration and Human Resources), has been appointed as the acting Director (Ports and Transport) in addition to his current duties.
caption:
A BIWTA Director has been suspended after viral videos alleging corruption and a personal scandal surfaced.

Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority (BIWTA) Director (Ports and Transport) AKM Arif Uddin has been temporarily suspended from service.

The action was taken following the publication of videos on social media platforms that alleged corruption, misconduct, and a scandal involving a woman.

BIWTA Chairman Md Muhidul Islam signed the office order on Tuesday, stating that the authority's image has been tarnished by these allegations.

The suspension is based on the violation of Rule 35(b) and (e) of the Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Authority Employees Service Regulations, 1990.

During the suspension, Arif Uddin will receive a food allowance as per rules, but he is required to attend the Administration and Human Resources Department of BIWTA regularly.

Md Saiful Islam, Director (Administration and Human Resources), has been appointed as the acting Director (Ports and Transport) in addition to his current duties.

#Bangladesh #BIWTA #Corruption #News #Government

Source: bdnews24.com, Somoy News
